notes: v6.2 - CLIPPING LEARNS TO READ THE CHAT. Live Clipping now captures the stream's live chat while it records: when chat velocity (unique chatters, link spam ignored) suddenly spikes, that moment becomes a clip. Ended streams and VODs run the same spike math over the chat replay, boosted by YouTube's Most replayed graph, and every clip says which signal found it. NEW Template frame (the default): animated streamer-name plate, the moment's headline landing word by word, the facecam auto-detected into its own panel (right / top / off), gameplay filling the frame with no blurred pad, a punch-in + flash opening, and audio normalised to -14 LUFS. Dull segments (menus, loading screens) are dropped automatically. The old frames remain as Simple choices, and every fallback from v6.1.1 still works. Your settings, keys and PRO unlock carry over.
